meta.title: Teacher Kim Reads My Post
meta.textType: story: feedback from a teacher and a classmate

paragraphs: On Thursday, July sixteenth, the Explorers met in the school library after lunch. Lily sat at a long table with Mia and Leo. She had a page with her post about the nature park. Teacher Kim always checked a post before it went on Explorers' Blog. "Has Teacher Kim read it yet?" asked Leo. "Not yet," said Lily. "But I have just given her the page."

Teacher Kim read the page slowly with a red pencil. "Your facts are excellent," she said at last. "You have already added the time, but you haven't added the date yet." "The date is important, because readers want to know when we went." Lily wrote "July eleventh" on her notepad. "Perhaps use a shorter title," said Teacher Kim. "A short title is easy to say." "Thank you, that is helpful advice," said Lily.

Mia read the page next. "I guess the lake part is the best," she said. "It is interesting." Leo looked at the page and said, "I agree with Mia, but it needs a joke." "A joke is fine if it is kind," said Teacher Kim. "Can you explain your joke, Leo?" "The birds sing at five o'clock," said Leo. "They are the first Explorers in the park!" Teacher Kim laughed and said, "That joke is kind, so please add it."

Then Lily looked at her page again. "Oh, I have just found a mistake!" she said. "I wrote five kilometers, but the path is four kilometers long." "Well done," said Teacher Kim. "Is it difficult to write a blog post?" asked Mia. "It is difficult at first," said Teacher Kim. "But you will improve with each new post."

At home, Lily added the date and corrected the number. She put the page on the table next to her laptop. Pip came into the room with his red ball. He jumped up and sat on the page. "Pip, I have already corrected that page!" said Lily. She laughed and lifted him off the page. Pip looked at her and wagged his tail.
